## Verification

- [ ] I ran the relevant tests and listed the command/output in the PR.
- [ ] I updated user-facing docs when behavior, packaging, or release flow changed.
- [ ] I did not add thesis files, repaired drafts, PDFs, API keys, logs, runtime/state/cache files, or unchecked feedback packages.
- [ ] If runtime rules changed, I updated tests and `config/capability_matrix.md`.
- [ ] If packaging changed, I updated the release docs/checklist and artifact verifier tests.
